description: Part/colour combinations observed in official LEGO sets modelled in LDraw. Used as evidence that a given part has genuinely been produced in a given colour. Coverage is limited to the sets in the OMR sample and is narrower than Rebrickable; a pair missing here is not proof that it does not exist, so the optimiser simply never proposes it.
